english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for pleading with someone or asking them for help.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when emotionally begging someone to do or not do something.
Use this as the all-purpose verb for humbly pleading with a person, often in 求你 or 求下你啦.
Use this when asking for something such as forgiveness, help, or a favor.

examples.english: I beg you to help me.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 kau4 nei5 bong1 haa5 ngo5 laa1

examples.english: I plead with you, please don't leave now.
examples.traditional: 我求吓你，唔好而家走呀。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 kau4 haa2 nei5 m4 hou2 ji4 gaa1 zau2 aa3

examples.english: I pray you give me five more minutes.
examples.jyutping: kau4 nei5 bei2 ngo5 do1 ng5 fan1 zung1 laa1
ngo5 kau4 nei5 jyun4 loeng6 ngo5 laa1
